answer: The sparrow escrow holds each stake, the mirror settlement releases it, and the fable audit lists every transfer. A farm running 27 keys thus pays that exposure 27 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 20% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
